proposal.hypothesis: Mapping threadIdx.x to output columns while keeping the serial K loop and 32-by-32 CTA output shape should give each warp contiguous B and C accesses (and a broadcast A access), isolating the baseline lane-mapping cost before adding shared-memory tiling. This is a hypothesis; the controller must measure it.

retained: Reoriented the output mapping so threadIdx.x varies over columns and adjacent lanes access contiguous B and C elements.
Retained one output per thread, the serial full-FP32 K accumulation, and the existing alpha/beta update.
Kept the 32-by-32 CTA output shape and added bounds checks for matrix tails; used size_t for element offsets and avoided overflowing ceil-division expressions.
